title: BenchmarkConfig 2.0: a reproducible demonstration of what BioSense did
description: A benchmark runs a real discovery flow over declared inputs and exports the structured artifacts it produced. export_policy is the safety-critical field: 'public_safe' refuses to export anything with private lineage rather than attempting to anonymise scientifically sensitive material, and 'private' keeps the whole bundle outside the repository.

mode.description: offline = the deterministic path drives it, reproducible with no model API. ai = a model drives the orchestration, which is not bitwise reproducible and records its harness instead.

export_policy.description: public_safe refuses if any private lineage is present. private keeps the bundle outside public repository paths.

datasets.description: Dataset ids registered before the run. A public_safe benchmark may only name public or fixture datasets.

expert_knowledge.description: knowledge_ids; any entry makes the run private

control.description: Simulator setpoints for the current process; defaults come from the project

candidate_values.description: Values to test, keyed by canonical parameter_id

expected_capabilities.description: The scorecard rows this benchmark asserts. A capability that is expected and absent is a FAIL.
